verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י בְּעַשְׁתֵּֽי־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·‘aš·tê- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: In the eleventh month of the twelfth . . . year on the first day of the month . . . the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: No undécimo ano, ao primeiro dia do mês, veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם יַ֠עַן אֲשֶׁר־ אָ֨מְרָה צֹּ֤ר עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ הֶאָ֔ח נִשְׁבְּרָ֛ה דַּלְת֥וֹת הָעַמִּ֖ים נָסֵ֣בָּה אֵלָ֑י אִמָּלְאָ֖ה הָחֳרָֽבָה׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām ya·‘an ’ă·šer- ’ā·mə·rāh ṣōr ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim he·’āḥ niš·bə·rāh dal·ṯō·wṯ hā·‘am·mîm nā·sêb·bāh ’ê·lāy ’im·mā·lə·’āh hā·ḥo·rā·ḇāh
verses.literal: Son of man because Tyre has said of Jerusalem Aha The gate to the nations is broken it has swung open to me now that she lies in ruins I will be filled
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, porquanto Tiro disse de Jerusalém: Ah! Já está quebrada aquela que era a porta dos povos; já se virou para mim; eu me encherei, agora que ela está assolada,

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י עָלַ֖יִךְ צֹ֑ר וְהַעֲלֵיתִ֤י עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים כְּהַעֲל֥וֹת הַיָּ֖ם לְגַלָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî ‘ā·la·yiḵ ṣōr wə·ha·‘ă·lê·ṯî ‘ā·la·yiḵ gō·w·yim rab·bîm kə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ hay·yām lə·ḡal·lāw
verses.literal: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says Behold O Tyre I am against you and I will raise up many nations against you as the sea brings up its waves
verses.literalPt: portanto assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Eis que sou contra ti, ó Tiro, e farei subir contra ti muitas nações, como o mar faz subir as suas ondas.

verses.original: וְשִׁחֲת֞וּ חֹמ֣וֹת צֹ֗ר וְהָֽרְסוּ֙ מִגְדָּלֶ֔יהָ וְסִֽחֵיתִ֥י עֲפָרָ֖הּ מִמֶּ֑נָּה וְנָתַתִּ֥י אוֹתָ֖הּ לִצְחִ֥יחַ סָֽלַע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ši·ḥă·ṯū ḥō·mō·wṯ ṣōr wə·hā·rə·sū miḡ·dā·le·hā wə·si·ḥê·ṯî ‘ă·p̄ā·rāh mim·men·nāh wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’ō·w·ṯāh liṣ·ḥî·aḥ sā·la‘
verses.literal: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and demolish her towers I will scrape the soil from her and make her a bare rock
verses.literalPt: Elas destruirão os muros de Tiro e deitarão abaixo as suas torres; também dela rasparei o seu pó e a farei uma rocha escalvada.

verses.original: מִשְׁטַ֨ח חֲרָמִ֤ים תִּֽהְיֶה֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַיָּ֔ם כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה וְהָיְתָ֥ה לְבַ֖ז לַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: miš·ṭaḥ ḥă·rā·mîm tih·yeh bə·ṯō·wḵ hay·yām kî ’ă·nî ḏib·bar·tî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lə·ḇaz lag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: She will become a place to spread nets in the sea for I have spoken declares the Lord GOD She will become plunder for the nations
verses.literalPt: Ela virá a ser no meio do mar um enxugadouro de redes, porque eu o falei, diz o Senhor Jeová; e servirá de despojo para as nações.

verses.original: וּבְנוֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה בַּחֶ֖רֶב תֵּהָרַ֑גְנָה וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā ’ă·šer baś·śā·ḏeh ba·ḥe·reḇ tê·hā·raḡ·nāh wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: and the villages on her mainland will be slain by the sword Then they will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Suas filhas que estão no campo serão mortas à espada; e saberão que eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֧י מֵבִ֣יא אֶל־ צֹ֗ר נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֧ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֛ל מִצָּפ֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ מְלָכִ֑ים בְּס֛וּס וּבְרֶ֥כֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁ֖ים וְקָהָ֥ל וְעַם־ רָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî mê·ḇî ’el- ṣōr nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn me·leḵ mə·lā·ḵîm bə·sūs ū·ḇə·re·ḵeḇ ū·ḇə·p̄ā·rā·šîm wə·qā·hāl wə·‘am- rāḇ
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says Behold I will bring against Tyre from the north Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon king of kings with horses and chariots with cavalry and a great company of troops
verses.literalPt: Pois assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Eis que da banda do Norte trarei contra Tiro a Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, o rei dos reis, com cavalos, e com carros, e com cavaleiros, e uma companhia, e muito povo.

verses.original: בְּנוֹתַ֥יִךְ בַּשָּׂדֶ֖ה בַּחֶ֣רֶב יַהֲרֹ֑ג וְנָתַ֨ן עָלַ֜יִךְ דָּיֵ֗ק וְשָׁפַ֤ךְ עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ סֹֽלְלָ֔ה וְהֵקִ֥ים עָלַ֖יִךְ צִנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nō·w·ṯa·yiḵ baś·śā·ḏeh ba·ḥe·reḇ ya·hă·rōḡ wə·nā·ṯan ‘ā·la·yiḵ dā·yêq wə·šā·p̄aḵ ‘ā·la·yiḵ sō·lə·lāh wə·hê·qîm ‘ā·la·yiḵ ṣin·nāh
verses.literal: He will slaughter the villages of your mainland with the sword he will set up siege works against you build a ramp to your walls . . . and raise his shields against you
verses.literalPt: Ele matará com a espada tuas filhas no campo. Construirá fortes contra ti, levantará contra ti um terrapleno e alçará o pavês contra ti.

verses.original: וּמְחִ֣י קָֽבָלּ֔וֹ יִתֵּ֖ן בְּחֹֽמוֹתָ֑יִךְ וּמִ֨גְדְּלֹתַ֔יִךְ יִתֹּ֖ץ בְּחַרְבוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mə·ḥî qā·ḇāl·lōw yit·tên bə·ḥō·mō·w·ṯā·yiḵ ū·miḡ·də·lō·ṯa·yiḵ yit·tōṣ bə·ḥar·ḇō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: He will direct the blows of his battering rams against your walls and tear down your towers with his axes
verses.literalPt: Disporá os seus aríetes contra os teus muros e, com os seus machados, derrubará as tuas torres.

verses.original: מִשִּׁפְעַ֥ת סוּסָ֖יו יְכַסֵּ֣ךְ אֲבָקָ֑ם מִקּוֹל֩ פָּרַ֨שׁ וְגַלְגַּ֜ל וָרֶ֗כֶב תִּרְעַ֙שְׁנָה֙ חֽוֹמוֹתַ֔יִךְ בְּבֹאוֹ֙ בִּשְׁעָרַ֔יִךְ כִּמְבוֹאֵ֖י עִ֥יר מְבֻקָּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: miš·šip̄·‘aṯ sū·sāw yə·ḵas·sêḵ ’ă·ḇā·qām miq·qō·wl pā·raš wə·ḡal·gal wā·re·ḵeḇ tir·‘aš·nāh ḥō·w·mō·w·ṯa·yiḵ bə·ḇō·’ōw biš·‘ā·ra·yiḵ kim·ḇō·w·’ê ‘îr mə·ḇuq·qā·‘āh
verses.literal: His multitude of horses will cover you in their dust When he enters your gates as an army entering a breached city your walls will shake from the noise of cavalry wagons and chariots
verses.literalPt: Por causa da multidão dos seus cavalos, te cobrirá o seu pó; ao estrondo dos cavaleiros, das carroças e dos carros, tremerão os teus muros, quando ele entrar pelas tuas portas como quem entra numa cidade em que está feita uma brecha.

verses.original: בְּפַרְס֣וֹת סוּסָ֔יו יִרְמֹ֖ס אֶת־ כָּל־ חֽוּצוֹתָ֑יִךְ עַמֵּךְ֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יַהֲרֹ֔ג וּמַצְּב֥וֹת עֻזֵּ֖ךְ לָאָ֥רֶץ תֵּרֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: bə·p̄ar·sō·wṯ sū·sāw yir·mōs ’eṯ- kāl- ḥū·ṣō·w·ṯā·yiḵ ‘am·mêḵ ba·ḥe·reḇ ya·hă·rōḡ ū·maṣ·ṣə·ḇō·wṯ ‘uz·zêḵ lā·’ā·reṣ tê·rêḏ
verses.literal: The hooves of his horses will trample all your streets He will slaughter your people with the sword and your mighty pillars will fall to the ground
verses.literalPt: Com as patas dos seus cavalos, pisará todas as tuas ruas; matará com a espada ao teu povo, e cairão por terra as colunas da tua fortaleza.

verses.original: וְשָׁלְל֣וּ חֵילֵ֗ךְ וּבָֽזְזוּ֙ רְכֻלָּתֵ֔ךְ וְהָֽרְסוּ֙ חוֹמוֹתַ֔יִךְ וּבָתֵּ֥י חֶמְדָּתֵ֖ךְ יִתֹּ֑צוּ וַאֲבָנַ֤יִךְ וְעֵצַ֙יִךְ֙ וַֽעֲפָרֵ֔ךְ בְּת֥וֹךְ מַ֖יִם יָשִֽׂימוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·lə·lū ḥê·lêḵ ū·ḇā·zə·zū rə·ḵul·lā·ṯêḵ wə·hā·rə·sū ḥō·w·mō·w·ṯa·yiḵ ū·ḇāt·tê ḥem·dā·ṯêḵ yit·tō·ṣū wa·’ă·ḇā·na·yiḵ wə·‘ê·ṣa·yiḵ wa·‘ă·p̄ā·rêḵ bə·ṯō·wḵ ma·yim yā·śî·mū
verses.literal: They will plunder your wealth and pillage your merchandise They will demolish your walls tear down your beautiful homes and throw your stones and timber and soil into the water
verses.literalPt: Despojarão as tuas riquezas e saquearão as tuas mercadorias; deitarão abaixo os teus muros, e destruirão as tuas casas agradáveis, e lançarão no meio das águas as tuas pedras, as tuas madeiras e o teu pó.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֖י הֲמ֣וֹן שִׁירָ֑יִךְ וְק֣וֹל כִּנּוֹרַ֔יִךְ לֹ֥א יִשָּׁמַ֖ע עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·bat·tî hă·mō·wn šî·rā·yiḵ wə·qō·wl kin·nō·w·ra·yiḵ lō yiš·šā·ma‘ ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: So I will silence the sound of your songs and the music of your lyres will no longer be heard
verses.literalPt: Farei cessar o arruído das tuas cantigas; e o som das tuas harpas não se ouvirá mais.

verses.original: וּנְתַתִּ֞יךְ לִצְחִ֣יחַ סֶ֗לַע מִשְׁטַ֤ח חֲרָמִים֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִבָּנֶ֖ה ע֑וֹד כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṯat·tîḵ liṣ·ḥî·aḥ se·la‘ miš·ṭaḥ ḥă·rā·mîm tih·yeh lō ṯib·bā·neh ‘ō·wḏ kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh dib·bar·tî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will make you a bare rock and you will become a place to spread the fishing nets You will never . . . be rebuilt for I the LORD have spoken declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Far-te-ei uma rocha escalvada; virás a ser um enxugadouro de redes; não tornarás a ser edificada. Pois eu Jeová o falei, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה לְצ֑וֹר הֲלֹ֣א׀ מִקּ֣וֹל מַפַּלְתֵּ֗ךְ בֶּאֱנֹ֨ק חָלָ֜ל בֵּהָ֤רֵֽג הֶ֙רֶג֙ בְּתוֹכֵ֔ךְ יִרְעֲשׁ֖וּ הָאִיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh lə·ṣō·wr hă·lō miq·qō·wl map·pal·têḵ be·’ĕ·nōq ḥā·lāl bê·hā·rêḡ he·reḡ bə·ṯō·w·ḵêḵ yir·‘ă·šū hā·’î·yîm
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says to Tyre Will not the coastlands quake at the sound of your downfall when the wounded . . . groan at the slaughter in your midst
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová a Tiro: Acaso, não tremerão as ilhas ao estrondo da tua queda, quando gemerem os feridos, quando se fizer a matança no meio de ti?

verses.original: וְֽיָרְד֞וּ מֵעַ֣ל כִּסְאוֹתָ֗ם כֹּ֚ל נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַיָּ֔ם וְהֵסִ֙ירוּ֙ אֶת־ מְעִ֣ילֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י רִקְמָתָ֖ם יִפְשֹׁ֑טוּ חֲרָד֤וֹת׀ יִלְבָּ֙שׁוּ֙ עַל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ יֵשֵׁ֔בוּ וְחָֽרְדוּ֙ לִרְגָעִ֔ים וְשָׁמְמ֖וּ עָלָֽיִךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·rə·ḏū mê·‘al kis·’ō·w·ṯām kōl nə·śî·’ê hay·yām wə·hê·sî·rū ’eṯ- mə·‘î·lê·hem wə·’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê riq·mā·ṯām yip̄·šō·ṭū ḥă·rā·ḏō·wṯ yil·bā·šū ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ yê·šê·ḇū wə·ḥā·rə·ḏū lir·ḡā·‘îm wə·šā·mə·mū ‘ā·lā·yiḵ
verses.literal: All the princes of the sea will descend from their thrones remove their robes and strip off their embroidered garments Clothed with terror they will sit on the ground trembling every moment appalled over you
verses.literalPt: Então, todos os príncipes do mar descerão dos seus tronos, e porão de lado os seus mantos, e despirão os seus vestidos bordados; de tremores se vestirão, sobre a terra se assentarão, estremecerão a cada momento e de ti se espantarão.

verses.original: וְנָשְׂא֨וּ עָלַ֤יִךְ קִינָה֙ וְאָ֣מְרוּ לָ֔ךְ אֵ֣יךְ אָבַ֔דְתְּ נוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת מִיַּמִּ֑ים הָעִ֣יר הַהֻלָּ֗לָה אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיְתָ֨ה חֲזָקָ֤ה בַיָּם֙ הִ֣יא וְיֹשְׁבֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּיתָ֖ם לְכָל־ יוֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·śə·’ū ‘ā·la·yiḵ qî·nāh wə·’ā·mə·rū lāḵ ’êḵ ’ā·ḇaḏt nō·wō·še·ḇeṯ mî·yam·mîm hā·‘îr ha·hul·lā·lāh ’ă·šer hā·yə·ṯāh ḥă·zā·qāh ḇay·yām hî wə·yō·šə·ḇe·hā ’ă·šer- nā·ṯə·nū ḥit·tî·ṯām lə·ḵāl yō·wō·šə·ḇe·hā
verses.literal: Then they will lament . . . for you saying How you have perished O city of renown inhabited by seafaring men she who was powerful on the sea along with her people who imposed terror on all peoples
verses.literalPt: Farão uma lamentação sobre ti e te dirão: Como pereceste, tu que foste povoada de navegantes, ó cidade afamada, que foste forte no mar, tu e teus habitantes, que fizestes cair o teu terror sobre todos os que te frequentam.

verses.original: עַתָּה֙ יֶחְרְד֣וּ הָֽאִיִּ֔ן י֖וֹם מַפַּלְתֵּ֑ךְ וְנִבְהֲל֛וּ הָאִיִּ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ בַּיָּ֖ם מִצֵּאתֵֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh yeḥ·rə·ḏū hā·’î·yin yō·wm map·pal·têḵ wə·niḇ·hă·lū hā·’î·yîm ’ă·šer- bay·yām miṣ·ṣê·ṯêḵ
verses.literal: Now the coastlands tremble on the day of your downfall the islands in the sea are dismayed by your demise
verses.literalPt: Agora, tremerão as ilhas no dia da tua queda, sim, as ilhas que estão no mar se espantarão da tua saída.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה בְּתִתִּ֤י אֹתָךְ֙ עִ֣יר נֶחֱרֶ֔בֶת כֶּעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ נוֹשָׁ֑בוּ בְּהַעֲל֤וֹת עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ אֶת־ תְּה֔וֹם וְכִסּ֖וּךְ הַמַּ֥יִם הָרַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bə·ṯit·tî ’ō·ṯāḵ ‘îr ne·ḥĕ·re·ḇeṯ ke·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer lō- nō·wō·šā·ḇū bə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ ‘ā·la·yiḵ ’eṯ- tə·hō·wm wə·ḵis·sūḵ ham·ma·yim hā·rab·bîm
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says When I make you a desolate city like other deserted . . . cities and when I raise up the deep against you so that the mighty waters cover you
verses.literalPt: Pois assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Quando eu te fizer uma cidade desolada, como as cidades que não são habitadas; quando eu fizer subir sobre ti o abismo, e as grandes águas te cobrirem,

verses.original: וְהוֹרַדְתִּיךְ֩ אֶת־ י֨וֹרְדֵי ב֜וֹר אֶל־ עַ֣ם עוֹלָ֗ם וְ֠הוֹשַׁבְתִּיךְ בְּאֶ֨רֶץ תַּחְתִּיּ֜וֹת כָּחֳרָב֤וֹת מֵֽעוֹלָם֙ אֶת־ י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֔וֹר לְמַ֖עַן לֹ֣א תֵשֵׁ֑בִי וְנָתַתִּ֥י צְבִ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·raḏ·tîḵ ’eṯ- yō·wr·ḏê ḇō·wr ’el- ‘am ‘ō·w·lām wə·hō·wō·šaḇ·tîḵ bə·’e·reṣ taḥ·tî·yō·wṯ kā·ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ mê·‘ō·w·lām ’eṯ- yō·wr·ḏê ḇō·wr lə·ma·‘an lō ṯê·šê·ḇî wə·nā·ṯat·tî ṣə·ḇî bə·’e·reṣ ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: then I will bring you down with those who descend to the Pit to the people of antiquity I will make you dwell in the earth below like the ancient ruins with those who descend to the Pit so that you will no longer be inhabited or set in splendor in the land of the living
verses.literalPt: então, te precipitarei juntamente com os que descem à cova, para ires ter com o povo antigo, e te farei habitar nas partes mais baixas da terra, nos lugares que são desolados de há muito, juntamente com os que descem à cova, para que não sejas habitada; e estabelecerei a glória na terra dos viventes.

verses.original: בַּלָּה֥וֹת אֶתְּנֵ֖ךְ וְאֵינֵ֑ךְ וּֽתְבֻקְשִׁ֗י וְלֹֽא־ תִמָּצְאִ֥י עוֹד֙ לְעוֹלָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bal·lā·hō·wṯ ’et·tə·nêḵ wə·’ê·nêḵ ū·ṯə·ḇuq·šî wə·lō- ṯim·mā·ṣə·’î ‘ō·wḏ lə·‘ō·w·lām nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will make you an object of horror and you will be no more You will be sought but will never . . . be found declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Far-te-ei um terror, e tu não serás mais; embora sejas procurada, contudo, nunca serás achada, diz o Senhor Jeová.
